test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statements and decide which of the given assumptions does not follow from the given statements:

Some Grass is Green.

All Green is Red.

options.text: Some Grass is Red and Green

solution:
__**Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7a25b3b6eaf917d80f9afc8e8ec9a7ff8f0191160ac9d9bf042f00d4bba162.png] 

__**Conclusions:**__

 
• Some Green is Grass - Follows (as some grass is green)
 
• Some Grass is Red - Follows (as some grass is green and all green is red)
 
• Some Grass is Red and Green - Follows (as some grass is green and conclusion 2 also holds)
 
• All Red is Green - Does not follow (it is possible but not definite)

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
